# Video Editor Mobile — Phase Two Critique

The Awtsmoos does not demand that short height become small intention;
Awtsmoos.com can reclaim vertical space without shrinking the very controls that move creation.

## What should not change

The first instinct could be to make the whole short-height timeline taller. That would be unnecessary and would steal preview space. Runtime evidence says the timeline geometry itself is healthy: 202–204px expanded, 54px retracted, 150px minimized, with zero document overflow.

The drawer also needs no redesign. At 390px it opens to 320px; at 320px it opens to 282px. Backdrop coverage is complete and closing returns the drawer fully off-canvas.

The off-screen Media-panel header buttons seen while the drawer is closed are intentional hidden drawer content, not escaped visible UI. Once opened, both are 44×44 and fully inside the drawer.

## Better correction

Preserve the short-height row calculation and transport padding, but stop overriding the button touch floor to 40px. Keep transport actions at 44px, which costs only four vertical pixels per button and still fits the existing 51px transport band.

Scope hover styling in `controls.css` under `(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)` rather than removing it. Keep the existing universal active transform and focus-visible behavior from the wider design system.

## Compact entry opportunity

`apps/video-editor/js/app.js` contains no top-level await and is already modular. After the UI fix passes runtime acceptance, compile it directly through CompactJS. Only if the generated bundle parses should the HTML module entry become `./js/app.js?compact=true`.

## Risk controls

- No controller changes.
- No timeline state changes.
- No drawer-state changes.
- No DOM restructuring.
- No new animation loops.
- No larger z-indexes.
- No new fixed-width geometry.
